matched_budget_control: For every random-arm task, compare the Stage-10 top-ranked subset with stratified random subsets of exactly the same size.
public_policy_rule: Choose one global fraction using only the four random-arm public tasks. Lexicographically maximize: robust task count, mean leave-one-session-out winner consensus, median relative SEI margin; break remaining ties by the smaller fraction. A robust task has a unique winner, full four-session coverage, and LOSO consensus >= required_loso_consensus.
reference_attack: Dobraunig et al. SIFA, practical SEI ranking
stage10_role: Rank paper-ineffective ciphertexts before the unweighted paper SEI; the model probability never enters the SEI equation.
